name: OpenResearch CLI (orx)
install: rustup update --no-self-update stable && rustup default stable && rustup component add rustfmt clippy && pnpm -C ui install --frozen-lockfile && cargo build --locked

terminals.name: orx dashboard
terminals.description: Runs `orx up`, the local dashboard and API on http://127.0.0.1:4791 (serves the embedded ui/dist).

terminals.name: ui dev server
terminals.description: Vite dev server for the dashboard on http://127.0.0.1:5173 with hot reload; proxies /api to the orx dashboard on port 4791.
